response.overview: The story follows Adam, an arrogant MMA fighter who has won a fight using dirty tactics. When challenged outside the Cage, Adam accidentally injures his opponent, Johan. Adam is burdened by guilt and worry because Johan knows that he is the cause of the injury. But over time, Adam has inadvertently become part of Johan's life. He then discovers that the injury that befell Johan has caused Lea and Reza, Johan's family members, to lose their source of income and hope. Will Adam be able to atone for his mistakes for the sake of Johan's and his siblings' future?
response.title: Sinopsis Filem Sangkar
